description: Adapts an existing workout for a user profile. Use when the user wants to customize a workout (duration, difficulty, equipment) without generating from scratch. Returns the adapted workout.

duration_max.description: Longest adapted workout length in minutes, 10 to 90.

duration_min.description: Shortest adapted workout length in minutes, 10 to 90.

end_user_fitness_levels.description: Member's fitness level as a one-item list, e.g. ["intermediate"]. Values: beginner, intermediate, advanced.

locale.description: Language for names and text, as a locale code, e.g. "en-US", "de-DE" or "de". Omit for the default language.

team_id.description: Not used: this tool works on the signed-in team. Leave it out.

user_requirements.description: Free-text guidance for the AI, up to 2000 characters, e.g. "Low impact, no jumping, knee friendly".

workout_id.description: Workout ID to adapt, from list_team_workouts or recommend_workouts.

name: adapt_workout
title: Adapt workout
